name: Charleston County, SC
findings: Charleston County has 1,688 nonprofit organizations. 698 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 556 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (20% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Charleston County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.text: 41 arts and cultural organizations here list membership, compared with about 19 in similar places of this size.
